goal: Make access explanations show only sources that actual enforcement reads.
runtime_operation_scope: Migrate data/contracts/ai/tools.json through the reviewed runtime-contract path if task 05 adds read-only access explain or editor-handoff tools; never commit the runtime copy.
acceptance: Direct Django permissions are absent from product access explanations unless an enforcement policy reads them.
Role, superuser, technical-group, ACL, and workflow sources remain distinguishable.
Memory technical-group behavior is unchanged and no group merge occurs.
AI can explain a selected user's effective access without exposing an access-mutation tool.
AI can return a server-authorized command that opens the existing human access editor for the selected user or role; applying changes still requires the editor's Save action.
